answer.summary: Spring context fails to start in every API test shard: the Spring Boot 4.x parent bump in pom.xml leaves a micrometer version mismatch, so DefaultMeterObservationHandler.builder is missing at runtime (NoSuchMethodError). The failure is deterministic and tied to the dependency change, so a retry will fail the same way. Failing tests are not a race or data problem.

evidence.quote: Correct the classpath of your application so that it contains compatible versions of the classes org.springframework.boot.micrometer.metrics.autoconfigure.MetricsAutoConfiguration and io.micrometer.core.instrument.observation.DefaultMeterObservationHandler
